selection_rule: Within each family/target, seed42 native validation BA chooses LR, then native minimum recall, then lower LR. Each run checkpoint uses native validation BA. Common-four scores use those same saved checkpoints.
limitations: Two model seeds reuse one fixed PDB-grouped validation split; sample SD measures model-seed variability and is not a confidence interval or grouped-fold result.
Target and family comparisons below pair nominal model seeds and validation cases but can use different per-variant native-selected LRs; they compare selected recipes, not a fixed-LR intervention.
Native 4/5/6 balanced accuracies average different classes; cross-target conclusions require common-four scores.
Native five-class Class VIII means Co+Ni; common-four VIII means Fe+Co+Ni.
Probability-sum collapse occurs before argmax; aggregate native confusion tables are not sufficient to reconstruct common-four predictions.
Native inverse-frequency weights, output heads and native selection objectives are part of each target recipe.
Common-four recall protection and native Fe/Co/Ni diagnostics answer different questions; weak Co recall does not invalidate the coarse endpoint but limits fine-metal claims.
No original-campaign per-pocket prediction export, paired case counts, confidence intervals, held-out evaluation or candidate promotion is claimed.
Original direct-four Only-GVP is the legacy architecture baseline, distinct from geometry arm A.
